summary: Pure calculation, classification or matching with defined examples and invariants and no I/O.

required_inputs.name: examples
required_inputs.description: Input and expected output pairs from an independent source, not derived from the implementation

required_inputs.name: invariants
required_inputs.description: Properties that must hold for every input

checklist.rule: Tests live beside the module and cover every example given as input
checklist.because: Flex quote logic regressions were caught only by co-located tests (docs/coding-agent-harnesses-2026-09-21.md, Flex section)

checklist.rule: The module performs no network, database or filesystem access
checklist.because: r3cruit3r tests that hid live API calls behind mocks reached the real Anthropic API (commit 063bbcb)

checklist.rule: Stop with an ASK if a business rule the examples depend on is listed as undecided
checklist.because: r3cruit3r ADR 0001 was reverted because an agent decided the merge threshold on the owner's behalf (commit 97a31c2)

done_output: test path and the test tail
the examples covered and any left uncovered with the reason
stop_conditions: a required invariant contradicts an example

adapter_fields.name: test_runner
adapter_fields.description: Command that runs the co-located tests, as an argument list

adapter_fields.name: typecheck_list
adapter_fields.description: File that enumerates scripts included in typecheck, if the repo has one
